description: A Flutter widget named CategoryList that displays a horizontally scrollable list of product categories with icons and labels, allowing users to select a category which triggers a fetch action via the ProductsProvider.

classes.name: CategoryList
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a horizontally scrollable list of category icons and labels for product browsing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the CategoryList, creating a scrollable list of category icons and labels. Handles tap events to fetch products by selected category.
